corpus.upstream_generation: IntegratedV05Brain with assembly/prediction/action disabled; adaptation learn_field=true, probes learn_field=false
corpus.freeze_rule: Generate and serialize one fixed internal-pattern corpus per seed before any assembly-order replay. Every arm reuses the identical frozen adaptation multiset and probe corpus.
corpus.isolation_rule: Only frozen ActivityPattern rows are replayed through assembly/prediction/action; field, receptor, homeostasis and plasticity are not rerun per order arm.

order_family.pair_rule: For each pair, create one deterministic pseudorandom permutation of the 48 adaptation episodes and pair it with the exact reversed permutation.
order_family.replay_time_rule: Assembly observe() receives monotonic synthetic replay time based only on replay rank and within-episode pattern index; ActivityPattern relative timing is unchanged.

native_path.prediction: current AssemblyPredictor semantics; predictor observes the episode future_event after each adaptation episode's strongest mature activation
native_path.action: current AssemblyActionPolicy; adaptation follows current deterministic exploration/reward semantics; probes use explore=false and no learning

comparator.component_maturity: component contains patterns from at least 3 distinct adaptation episodes
comparator.episode_component_rule: Choose the mature component with maximum pattern-to-component-member similarity across the episode; ties break by canonical component id.
comparator.prediction_rule: Order-invariant majority future_event per mature component; ties break lexicographically.

structural_metrics.representation_divergent_pair: true iff paired arms differ in mature assembly count OR pairwise co-clustering disagreement is greater than 0.0; unassigned patterns never co-cluster with one another

functional_metrics.prediction_disagreement: count of the 16 fixed probe episodes whose predicted value differs between paired arms, including None-vs-value
functional_metrics.prediction_coverage_delta: arm_a coverage minus arm_b coverage over the 16 probes
functional_metrics.prediction_accuracy_delta: arm_a accuracy minus arm_b accuracy against probe future_event over the 16 probes
functional_metrics.descriptive_action_disagreement: count of fixed probes whose deterministic explore=false action differs between paired arms

support_rule.NO_OR_LOW_SUPPORT: if either development seed has representation_divergent_pairs < 4 of 12
support_rule.FUNCTIONAL_ORDER_LOCKIN_SIGNAL: if both development seeds have representation_divergent_pairs >= 8 of 12 AND prediction_disagreement >= 2 of 16 in >= 8 of 12 order pairs
support_rule.REPRESENTATION_ONLY: if both development seeds have representation_divergent_pairs >= 8 of 12 but FUNCTIONAL_ORDER_LOCKIN_SIGNAL is false

stop_condition: After one valid mapped result, STOP for fresh Evidence Analyst review. No same-object redesign, retune, threshold search, extra permutations, PRE_FORMAL promotion or FORMAL promotion.
